items.new_text: Given some reminders or parked triage items could not be read (a project cannot be read, the request failed, or parked triage could not be checked), when any page is open, then the sidebar Inbox badge shows an exclamation mark next to the count (alone when nothing could be counted) with a screen-reader label saying some reminders could not be read; damaged lines alone do not raise it.

Given a parked triage row in the Inbox, when the operator presses Open in Triage, then Triage opens with that exact entry's detail already showing (matched by project and entry together); a stale or unknown link just leaves the normal list, and the link is used once so closing the detail, reloading or going Back never reopens it.

Given a registered project has no triage log at all, when the Inbox checks for expired parked triage, then it counts as nothing parked and the orange banner saying parked triage could not be checked is not shown, while any other reading failure still shows it.
